rules: The declaration must predate the edit and remain immutable.
The final candidate SHA must identify the post-edit Blend actually used for evidence.
Edited vertices must be a subset of the declaration's allowed_edit_vertex_ids.
Edited bone groups must be a subset of the declaration's allowed_bones.
Protected-neighbour vertices may not be edited.
Forbidden operations from the declaration may not appear in executed_operations.
This record is engineering provenance only and never implies owner acceptance or production approval.
